A -nd- word standing alone, neuter and
singular, is a gerund — a noun.
A -nd- word that AGREES with a noun in
gender, number and case is something
else: a gerundive, a verbal adjective.
Both come out in English as '-ing'.
Latin keeps them apart by the ending.
